1B89.name: Iris and box size
desc: Size of a growing/shrinking window effect: the iris radius on the Lives exchange screen, the half-width in
pixels (0-$50) of the message box window, and a scene timer/fade progress in the credits.
Written by the iris, message box and credits setup code, read by the window HDMA code ($0C wipe update).
Credits setup stores $E2 here as the starting position of the transition (probably).

1B8A.name: Lives exchange selected player
desc: Player chosen on the Lives exchange screen (the one with more lives). Stored when the iris effect starts and
compared on later frames to detect whether the selection changed.

1B8B.name: Lives exchange cursor blink timer
desc: Cursor blink timer on the Lives exchange screen. Restarted to $18 when the selected player changes.

1B8C.name: Overworld iris direction
desc: Direction of the overworld submap-switch iris: 0 = closing, 2 = opening.
Cleared when Mario starts walking a path ($04:9628); read as an index by the submap switch states.
Values: 0 = closing, 2 = opening.

1B8D.name: Overworld iris width
desc: Current width value of the overworld submap-switch iris. Starts at $7000 when Mario walks a path and is
increased by a width step each frame of the switch. Partner of $1B8F (height).

1B8F.name: Overworld iris height
desc: Current height value of the overworld submap-switch iris. Starts at $5400 when Mario walks a path and is
increased by a height step each frame of the switch. Partner of $1B8D (width).

1B91.name: Menu cursor blink counter
desc: Frame counter incremented by the menu cursor handler; the blinking menu cursor drawing routine reads it to
decide whether the cursor is visible this frame.

1B92.name: Menu cursor position
desc: Current cursor position in the title/file select style menus. Cleared at Nintendo Presents, set to the file
number in the erase file menu, and used as the index by the cursor handler and the cursor drawing routine.

1B93.name: Secondary exit flag
desc: Flag from the level's exit data marking that a screen exit is a secondary exit. Stored by the screen exit
object loader ($0D:A539) and read by the level load code ($05:D7D4, $05:D94C) to choose the entry setup.

1B94.name: Bonus game initialized flag
desc: Set (incremented) after the bonus game sprite (sprite 82) has run its init, so the init is done only once.
Also tested by the level-end coin sprite code ($00:FC81).

1B95.name: Yoshi wings level flag
desc: Nonzero while Mario is in the Yoshi wings bonus area (a special level reached with Yoshi wings; probably).
Read by level start, P-switch/fall-off, level load, screen exit and Yoshi code. The wings exit animation
uses it as a phase: 0 = going out, 2 = coming back.

1B9A.name: Layer 2 scroll trigger
desc: Background scroll status for the flying grey turnblocks: set to 8 when the movement starts, 0 while not
yet triggered. Also read by scroll sprite 0B (layer 2 ON/OFF switch). Orange platform writes 1 (unused).
Values: 0 = not activated, 8 = activated.

1B9B.name: Keep reserve item flag
desc: Set to 1 by the scripted level-end walk. Mario's death routine keeps the reserve item if it is 1.
Also read by the extended sprite hitbox code ($02:A768).

1B9E.name: Overworld flag, purpose unclear
desc: Set to 1 when Mario starts walking along an overworld path; cleared on overworld load, submap switch
finish and when a button is pressed on a tile. Purpose unclear from the code.

1BA0.name: Overworld earthquake timer
desc: Countdown used by the overworld; set to $FF by an overworld event (earthquake per the original note),
decremented by the overworld game mode and read by the path-walking code.

1BA1.name: Current level screen number
desc: Screen number the level object loader is working on. Set per object, incremented by the rectangle object
helpers when an object crosses into the next screen, and restored from $1928 afterwards.

1BA2.name: Mode 7 graphics index
desc: Index into the Mode 7 boss picture data: kid row + frame + flip for Morton/Roy/Ludwig, $2C for the Reznor
ring, and set by Bowser. Read by the Mode 7 positioning/tilemap routine.

1BA3.name: Mode 7 pixel plane buffer
desc: Scratch buffer for Mode 7 boss graphics setup; collects the three bit planes of each pixel into a 3-bit
color, rotating them down per byte.

1BB2.name: 3bpp to 4bpp conversion buffer
desc: Scratch buffer for the 3bpp to 4bpp graphics converter: planes 0-1 are stored, planes 2-3 are ORed in
before the tile is uploaded to VRAM.

1BE3.name: Layer 3 type
desc: Layer 3 (BG3) type for the level, from DATA_05D78A at level load. Used by the layer 3 setup routines.
Values: 0 = none.

1BE4.name: Layer 1 update VRAM address high
desc: High byte of the VRAM address of the pending layer 1 tile update; 0 = no update. Tested by the NMI
VRAM uploader; written by the layer 2 stripe builders ($05:8A11) as well. Partner of $1BE5.

1BE5.name: Layer 1 update VRAM address low
desc: Low byte of the pending layer 1 update VRAM address. Read by the NMI VRAM uploaders, written by the
stripe builders. See $1BE4.

1BE6.name: Layer 1 update buffer, left column
desc: Buffer of tile words for the left column of a layer update; the stripe builder writes word 0
(top-left 8x8 tile) here, uploaded by NMI. Companion buffer at $1C66.

1C66.name: Layer 1 update buffer, right column
desc: Second buffer of tile words for a pending layer update, written by the stripe builders at $05:8A7E.
See $1BE6.

1CE6.name: Layer 2 update VRAM address high
desc: High byte of the VRAM address of the pending layer 2 tile update; 0 = no update. Tested by the NMI
VRAM uploader and written by the layer 2 stripe builders. Partner of $1CE7.

1CE7.name: Layer 2 update VRAM address low
desc: Low byte of the pending layer 2 update VRAM address. Read by NMI uploaders, written by the stripe
builders. See $1CE6.

1CE8.name: Layer 2 update buffer, left column
desc: Buffer of tile words for the left column of a layer 2 update; word 0 (top-left 8x8 tile) goes here.
Companion buffer at $1D68.

1D68.name: Layer 2 update buffer, right column
desc: Second buffer of tile words for a pending layer 2 update, written by the stripe builders ($05:8C52).
See $1CE8.

1DE8.name: Submap switch state
desc: Overworld submap switch state. Incremented to advance to the next step (iris, draw map page), cleared
when the switch finishes. Also read by the NMI handler and the overworld sprite code.

1DE9.name: Scene / event counter
desc: Multi-purpose scene counter. In the ending and credits it is the scene number (0 = Lakitu ... 12 = Bowser).
On the overworld it flags a pending event (0 = none). Also incremented as a transition counter in level
and cutscene code (probably). Meaning depends on game mode.

1DEA.name: Overworld event number
desc: Number of the overworld event being run (for example a path or tile reveal after a level is beaten).
Read by the event state machine, tile edit, smoke puff and tile replacement routines.

1DEB.name: Overworld event tile index
desc: Index of the current event tile record. Set to the event's first record, incremented per tile, and
compared with $1DED to know when the event is finished.

1DED.name: Overworld event end index
desc: Index one past the last tile record of the current event (the next event's first). See $1DEB.

1DF0.name: Saved overworld X scroll
desc: Copy of the overworld X scroll saved by the overworld game mode.

1DF2.name: Saved overworld Y scroll
desc: Copy of the overworld Y scroll saved by the overworld game mode.

1DF5.name: General delay timer
desc: Frame countdown used in several non-level modes: Nintendo Presents screen ($40 frames), title demo time
left, overworld load delay ($B0), level-end walk ($A0). Decremented by those modes.

1DF7.name: Star warp fly speed
desc: Speed of the star during the star warp fly-away on the overworld. Cleared when a button is pressed on a
tile and increased by the level name/star code. Partner of $1DF8.

1DF8.name: Star ground timer
desc: Frames the star stays on the ground before flying away on the overworld. Cleared on tile button press,
incremented by the star code. Partner of $1DF7.

1DF9.name: Sound effect port 1
desc: Sound effect request, port 1 ($2142 mirror). Written with a sound number by Mario, sprites and menus.
The NMI handler sends it to the APU and clears it. Examples: $0A power-up, $04 pipe, $FF hurry up (music).
Values: 0 = no request.

1DFA.name: Sound effect port 2
desc: Sound effect request, port 2 ($2141 mirror). Written by Mario (jump, $01), Yoshi mount ($02), grinders
($04) and others; cleared by the NMI handler after it is sent.
Values: 0 = no request.

1DFB.name: Music request
desc: Music change request sent to the APU by the NMI handler. Written by level start, power-ups, death, goal
and boss code. Examples: $09 death, $0B course clear, $0C level clear, $0D star music, $80 fade out.
Values: 0 = no request.

1DFC.name: Sound effect port 3
desc: Sound effect request, port 3 ($2143 mirror), the most used sound port. Written by Mario, sprites, bosses
and menus (confirm = 1, door $0F, impact $09). Sent and cleared by the NMI handler.
Values: 0 = no request.

1E01.name: Debug mode
desc: Debug mode cycled by Mario's per-frame handling: 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 0 each time it is triggered.

1E02.name: Cluster/extended sprite Y low
desc: Low byte of the Y position of a cluster sprite (or other small sprite slot such as the keyhole and Sumo
Bro flame). Set at spawn from screen position and data; used by Boo/bat ceiling, 1-up bonus and candle flames.
Partner high bytes are in separate tables.

1E16.name: Cluster/extended sprite X low
desc: Low byte of the X position of a cluster sprite or small sprite slot (Sumo Bro flames, keyhole, Boo ring).
Moved by X speed ($1E66) each frame. Partner of $1E02 (Y low).
